def: Evaluating fairness across combinations of attributes, such as gender and skin type together, because disparities can stay hidden when each attribute is examined alone.
practice: Gender Shades (Buolamwini and Gebru, 2018) found commercial gender classifiers erred up to 34.7% for darker-skinned women versus 0.8% for lighter-skinned men; more slices mean smaller samples, so report intervals.
